name: Mount Perazim
line: Mount Perazim is a mountain named only in Isaiah, where it recalls a time when the LORD rose up to act, and it warns of coming judgment.

moments.title: David defeats the Philistines
moments.text: Easton's Bible Dictionary says Mount Perazim is the same as Baal-perazim, where David won a victory over the Philistines. Isaiah points back to it, saying the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim.
